source.name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / Tilezen Joerd), Terrarium encoding
source.attribution: Elevation: Terrain Tiles by Mapzen, hosted by AWS Open Data. United States 3DEP (formerly NED) terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
source.processing: Zoom 12 tiles mosaicked, bilinearly resampled to a regular longitude/latitude grid, and stored as 16-bit integers in 0.1 m steps.
